feeds.title: Flint Rehab
feeds.description: Discover an extensive stroke recovery blog with 300 articles that cover everything from treatment to rehabilitation to regaining independence after stroke.

feeds.title: Deans' stroke musings
feeds.description: This blog is an attempt to cover all stroke rehabilitation information that should be readily available to survivors so they can talk with informed knowledge to their medical staff. The blog contains my personal ideas on stroke rehabilitation and stroke research

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Stroke News
feeds.description: Latest medical research on stroke risk and treatments. Read about the symptoms of mini-strokes, stroke rehabilitation and recovery.

feeds.title: News Medical » Stroke News
feeds.description: Get Latest Ischemic Stroke News and Research by following this site by News Medical which is an online, open-access medical information provider for healthcare professionals, medical researchers and engaged consumers.

feeds.title: Different Strokes News
feeds.description: Reclaiming lives after Stroke We help younger Stroke Survivors reclaim their lives through active peer support and independent recovery. Different Strokes is a charity run by younger stroke survivors for younger stroke survivors.

feeds.title: Neurolutions News
feeds.description: Neurolutions' blog is a useful resource for clinicians, caregivers, and stroke survivors who are looking to learn more. Neurolutions is a medical device company developing neuro-rehabilitation solutions that utilize a patient's own brain activity to facilitate motor recovery.

feeds.title: Stronger After Stroke
feeds.description: The author is a science communicator.Research associate and co-director at the Neuromotor Recovery and Rehabilitation Laboratory.This blog contains the author various personal opinion and tips for stroke recovery.

feeds.title: The Stroke Blog
feeds.description: Stroke information and stories made easy to understand.The Stroke Blog aims to educate the public about stroke through patient stories and explanations of stroke-related stories.

feeds.title: Home After a Stroke
feeds.description: A blog about an occupational therapist who specialized in stroke rehab and continued her education by having a stroke.

feeds.title: It's Never Been Better Blog
feeds.description: This blog chronicles the story of my recovery from stroke, the ups and downs, triumphs, struggles, and changes that have come along for the ride; my new-found desire to learn all I can about stroke and movement disorders, and my enjoyment in learning to be an adult - a second time!

feeds.title: Stroke of Faith
feeds.description: This Christ-centered blog is designed to serve stroke survivors, families and friends, through sharing experience and faith. My own stroke came on May 8, 1998. This blog stands for faith in God and better stroke awareness. Everyone should be aware of stroke signs.

feeds.title: The Tales of a Stroke Patient and More
feeds.description: The Blog contains the author true story behind her stroke, consequences, including deplorable nurses, gruesome depression and much more.

feeds.title: Life After a CVA (aka Stroke)
feeds.description: I have been dabbling in graphic designs, mostly digital scrapbook related images, since January 2008., I suffered a stroke(blood clot in my brain) in July of 2013. This blog describes my life journey after the stroke.

feeds.title: Stroke Onward Blog
feeds.description: Stroke Onward's mission is to provide stroke survivors, families, and caregivers with more resources to help them navigate the emotional journey to rebuild their identities and rewarding lives. Follow to get the latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: Saebo Blog
feeds.description: Saebo is a leading provider of innovative rehabilitation products for stroke survivors. Discover a variety of articles, tips and personal stories about stroke on Saebo Blog.

feeds.title: Canadian Partnership for Stroke Recovery
feeds.description: We restore quality of life to people affected by stroke by harnessing the collective expertise of leading national and international stroke recovery researchers to create, share and apply new knowledge.
